title: schoenoplectus juncoides subsp. triangulatus
intro: Schoenoplectus juncoides subsp. triangulatus, commonly known as Three-way Bulrush or Triangular Bulrush, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the sedge family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues, offering potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Schoenoplectus juncoides subsp. triangulatus may include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which are primarily flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
